description: Externalized error codes. businessMessage goes to UI; technicalDetail goes to logs only.

AUTH_001.businessMessage: Authentication required. Please reconnect your brokerage account.

AUTH_002.businessMessage: E*TRADE connection expired. Please reconnect your account in Settings.
AUTH_002.technicalDetail: E*TRADE OAuth access token is missing in PROD mode

QUOTE_001.businessMessage: Unable to retrieve live quotes. The screener will use the most recent available data.
QUOTE_001.technicalDetail: E*TRADE OAuth access token missing or expired

QUOTE_003.businessMessage: Some symbols could not be quoted. Results show available data.
QUOTE_003.technicalDetail: E*TRADE returned empty response for batch

QUOTE_004.businessMessage: Quote data format unexpected. Using cached data where available.
QUOTE_004.technicalDetail: E*TRADE response JSON parse failed or unexpected structure

QUOTE_005.businessMessage: Market data delayed. Prices may not reflect current market.
QUOTE_005.technicalDetail: Quote returned zero/negative price (market closed or stale)

QUOTE_006.businessMessage: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.

SYS_001.businessMessage: An unexpected error occurred. Our team has been notified.

WATCHLIST_001.businessMessage: Watchlist is not available. Your portfolio data is shown below.

AUTH_003.businessMessage: No E*TRADE session is stored for this account. Please connect your account in Settings.
AUTH_003.technicalDetail: No E*TRADE OAuth token set exists in the SessionStore for the user in the resolved environment

SCREEN_001.technicalDetail: Screener run completed with success=false; see the run error detail

SCREEN_002.businessMessage: The screen published qualified partial results — some symbols could not be evaluated.
SCREEN_002.technicalDetail: Partial coverage: a subset of the universe evaluated; failure reasons recorded on the run

SCREEN_003.businessMessage: The options screen was discarded — no contracts could be evaluated.
SCREEN_003.technicalDetail: Options scan evaluated zero contracts (chain fetch or coverage failure); run discarded by the coverage gate

REPORT_001.businessMessage: The PDF report could not be generated.
REPORT_001.technicalDetail: Report pipeline PDF render failed; pdfError recorded on the run

REPORT_002.businessMessage: The XLSX report could not be generated.
REPORT_002.technicalDetail: Report pipeline XLSX generation failed; xlsxError recorded on the run

REPORT_003.businessMessage: The generated report file could not be found for delivery.
REPORT_003.technicalDetail: Follow-up report job found no adoptable artifact for the run's recorded keys

DELIVER_001.businessMessage: The delivery recipient is not on the screener email allowlist; delivery refused.
DELIVER_001.technicalDetail: Effective recipient failed isEmailAllowed against SCREENER_EMAIL_ALLOWLIST / run-owner rule

DELIVER_002.businessMessage: Report delivery failed on this channel.
DELIVER_002.technicalDetail: Delivery port returned ok=false or threw; see the transport detail

DATA_001.businessMessage: A market-data provider was unavailable; results may be partial.
DATA_001.technicalDetail: Provider fetch failed after policy retries (e.g. Yahoo throttling/unreachable); symbols dropped as provider-unavailable

MCP_001.businessMessage: This tool is not available for your current access level.
MCP_001.technicalDetail: MCP tool permission scope not held by caller principal
